api.notes: `title` is a global attribute and is never shadowed (A§7.1); a heading is `heading` (+ slot="heading" for rich content), A§7.2.
Plain text; the `description` slot carries rich content.
Wrapped in an aria-hidden container, drawn only when slotted.
Row by default, column when compact.
Attribute heading-level; invalid values fall back to 3.

api.reason: A-xstyle: use class/style, ::part(base|icon|title|description|actions) or the tokens.

differences.text: role="status" is the default ElementInternals role of the host (not a role attribute), so a host role attribute overrides it. The title is a native h1-h6 inside the shadow root chosen with a switch over six static templates; no dynamic tag names are ever created.
`title` (the message) is `heading` because `title` is a global attribute; rich titles and descriptions use the `heading` and `description` slots (upstream accepted only strings for both).

core.empty-state.notes: Guides: [mwg:shadow-dom] slot presence and whitespace; [mwg:accessible-web-components] status role through ElementInternals; [mwg:styling-web-components] parts and private custom properties.
